tools.name: workflow_seal
tools.description: Seals a closed workflow for durable export. Requires the matching job session and an active pass. Never spends, captures, or starts a payment. The export remains a Zambo claim, not issuer authentication.

tools.name: zambo_universal
tools.description: Universal Zambo entry point for routing natural-language requests across supported Zambo tools through one MCP connection. Covers strategy, code audits, lead generation, wallet intelligence, provenance certificates, swarm coordination, and live market data. Returns a route, execution state, downstre

tools.name: new_session
tools.description: Starts fresh session context and returns a new session_id. Reuse that ID on subsequent calls for continuity; changing or omitting it starts clean context.

tools.name: continuity_get_recent
tools.description: Reads only the private receipt timeline for the supplied job or thread ID. Returns receipt links, has_more, and a cursor for the next page. Use since to filter by an inclusive RFC3339 timestamp. Optional AI client labels are self-reported, not verified.

tools.name: continuity_list_threads
tools.description: Lists named threads owned by the supplied job ID. Thread IDs can be used as _session_id by another AI client.

tools.name: continuity_open_thread
tools.description: Opens a named thread or thread ID and returns only events with stored Zambo receipts, including links to open and check each receipt.

tools.name: continuity_start_thread
tools.description: Creates or reuses a named thread under an existing job ID. Pass the returned thread_id as _session_id to append work from another AI client.

tools.name: continuity_set_prefs
tools.description: Changes whether future successful calls are captured in the private timeline. It does not remove or hide public receipts already created.

tools.name: journal_log
tools.description: Free anonymous or authenticated append-only log for an action performed outside Zambo. The entry is recorded as an agent-reported claim; Zambo does not claim it ran or observed the action. Limited to 20 calls per IP per day on the free tier.

tools.name: live_price
tools.description: Real-time cryptocurrency price lookup for supported coins. Uses CoinGecko first, Coinbase as a secondary no-key provider, then the most recent cached verified value with its age if both live providers are unavailable. Returns live USD price, 24-hour percentage change, and market capitalization when

tools.name: pdf_extract
tools.description: Fetch and extract text content from any public URL - PDF documents, web pages, articles, docs. Returns the extracted text, word count, and a summary. tools.name: leadsignal
tools.description: AI lead generation for contractors and local service businesses. Accepts a trade type and city. Returns qualified local leads with available contact information.

tools.name: provibe_audit
tools.description: AI code audit for a public GitHub repository. Returns a Provibe score from 0 to 100, security vulnerabilities, a dead-code map, and an execution plan for addressing the findings.

tools.name: ghost_audit_site
tools.description: Achilles 10-stage audit for a website. Returns SEO gaps, AI discoverability issues, conversion leaks, brand-presence gaps, competitor intelligence, a score from 0 to 100, stage findings, an audit ID, a live stream URL, and a report URL.

tools.name: ghost_audit_status
tools.description: Status report for a Ghost Audit identified by audit_id. Returns whether the audit is running or complete, along with elapsed-time information and report availability.

tools.name: ghost_audit_report
tools.description: Full markdown report for a completed Ghost Audit. Returns the Achilles 10-stage score, severity-ranked findings, stage analysis, and recommended fixes.

tools.name: credithunt
tools.description: Live verified index of AI and cloud startup credit programs. Accepts optional stack, stage, and minimum value filters. Returns count, updated_at, opportunities, and api.

tools.name: prompt_shield
tools.description: Detection and analysis of prompt injection, jailbreak, and policy-bypass attempts. Returns an injection risk score, a safe/review/block recommendation, attack indicators, and a safe rewritten version when available.

tools.name: day_pass_checkout_link
tools.description: Create a 30-minute short link for a human-approved $0.99, 24-hour Day Pass by card or PayPal. Optional workflow_id targets a closed run; sponsor:true explicitly lets you pay to seal another team's run without transferring branding ownership. The link is not an order or charge.

tools.name: day_pass_activate
tools.description: Agent-native access activation endpoint. Accepts an optional payment envelope or existing access key and returns a payment challenge or verified activation result. tools.name: day_pass_status
tools.description: Check a Day Pass using _zambo_key, X-Zambo-Key, or the same _session_id used at card checkout or x402 payment. Returns active, expires_at, and calls_left without spending quota. Gateway calls are unmetered while active; product/provider limits may still apply. Never returns the key.

tools.name: capability_search
tools.description: Search across the supported Zambo tool catalog for a use case. Returns relevant tools with relevance scores, descriptions, taglines, and callable API endpoints.
